name: Hoi An
provinceNote: Hoi An was in Quang Nam, which merged into Da Nang in 2025. Search and book it as Hoi An.
summary: Hoi An is a preserved trading port of wooden shophouses, a Japanese covered bridge, and a river that floods in the late-year rains. Two nights lets you walk the old town in the day and again after the shops thin out. The ancient-town ticket covers a set of old houses, museums, and a performance.
fee: Ancient-town ticket for the old houses; streets are free to walk
getThere: 30–45 minutes by car from Da Nang airport
seoTitle: Hoi An travel guide — what to do, how to get there, where to eat
seoDescription: How to spend two days in Hoi An, what the ancient-town ticket covers, and why October floods change the plan.
intro: Hoi An was a trading port where Japanese, Chinese, and later French merchants left shops and assembly halls. The old town is small. You can walk it in a morning and still spend the next day on a bicycle to the beach, a cooking class, or the ruins at My Son.

Tailors will find you. Use one with time for a fitting if you actually want clothes. The monthly lantern nights are crowded and pretty. In October and November the river can rise into the streets; check the season desk and do not plan museum time during a flood peak.
gettingAround: A taxi or prebooked car from Da Nang airport takes under an hour outside rush traffic. Grab works once you have a local SIM. Bicycles are the right tool for An Bang beach and the rice-field edge of town. The old-town core is walking only in the evening pedestrian hours.

stayAreas.name: Old town edge
stayAreas.summary: Walk to dinner. Book early in the dry months. Some lanes are noisy.

stayAreas.name: An Bang
stayAreas.summary: A beach base, 10–15 minutes by bicycle from the old town.

eat: Cao lau, banh mi, white rose dumplings, and com ga are the local set. Eat cao lau in Hoi An; it does not travel well.
The river restaurants sell the view. The better bowls are often a street back from the water.
interestsBody: Old streets, food, and photographs. The beach is a bonus, not the reason. My Son is the history add-on, a morning trip.

faqs.q: Is Hoi An worth visiting in October?
faqs.a: October and November are the flood months. The town can be beautiful and knee-deep on the same week. If your dates are fixed, keep a Da Nang beach hotel as a backup.

faqs.q: Do you need the ancient-town ticket?
faqs.a: You need it for the old houses and assembly halls on the ticket. You can walk the streets, eat, and cross the bridge area without buying every museum.

season.label: Flood risk Sep–Nov
season.note: The old town floods most years in the late rainy season. A field report on this page will say if the streets are open.
